ITEM 1 | Long strips of cooked flat meat, reddish-brown to deep amber with crisp browned edges and lighter fatty streaks, wavy and curled, several strips overlapping, about 15 cm long and 1.5 cm wide each, slightly glossy with rendered fat, firm and crisp at edges | 75
ITEM 2 | Cylindrical slices of cooked sausage-like meat, reddish-brown with darker browned rims and a slightly glossy surface, about 2.5 cm diameter and 1 cm thick, four to five pieces stacked and scattered at the upper right of the plate | 60
ITEM 3 | Cubes of yellow fruit with pale golden flesh and slightly darker caramelized edges, moist and firm, cut into roughly 2 cm chunks, clustered at the lower left of the plate | 110
ITEM 4 | Small whole round green-brown vegetables with charred, blistered, dark outer leaves and slightly shiny surfaces, about 2 to 3 cm diameter, roughly eight pieces scattered in the center right of the plate, some with dark crisp leaf edges | 60
ITEM 5 | Small dark brown to black crisp fragments, thin and curled like burnt leaf bits, scattered in a small cluster near the center of the plate among the green vegetables | 3
